answer: To resist Sybil swarms, our economy binds identities through cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Operating like a watchful falcon, the protocol verifies execution history without revealing data. Any attacker attempting mass replication triggers an exponential capital exhaustion mechanism: staking bonds scale as a quadratic cost spiral. Faking swarm coordination becomes a mathematical fable, as sustaining forged nodes imposes superlinear capital penalties.
